errors.says: Three stages of forward invocations y_S -> y_S + x_S send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a).
errors.paper: Stage 1 is a forward invocation from X to Y, stage 2 is the inverse forward schedule from Y to X (effecting X <- X - Y), and stage 3 is a forward invocation from X to Y; three forward X-to-Y stages would not exchange the banks. S2.1.7 states this correctly.

errors.says: Every nonzero binary residual is nonalternating because it contains a norm-one coordinate vector outside the supports of the earlier tensor vectors.
errors.paper: Coordinate units are found only in B, Q^perp, triple complements and full tensor spaces; the lines P, Q, <t> have norm-one vectors that are not coordinate vectors, and a norm-one vector of each tensor summand is the tensor of these chosen vectors (for example the residual P tensor <t_Y> contains no coordinate vector).

errors.says: The computed source transform is 2^gamma B_0 C~ A, with the exact Gaussian maps A and B_0 around the computed chirp transform.
errors.paper: The procedure applies the linewise approximation to A, the computed chirp transform, then the linewise approximation to B_0, then scales by 2^gamma; their approximation errors (dp^2 each) enter the 2dp^2 + 8TL bound.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route all the way to the main bound. It goes from the scalar bank exchange, frames, labels, rank budget and exponent (S2.1-S2.5) through the shear factorisation and the power-width and arbitrary-width interchange (S2.6-S2.8), then the phase-frame butterfly layer with packed basis changes and guard widths (S2.9), synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S3), resampling, chirp and permutation cancellation (S4), parameters, the CRT map and the algorithm (S5), exact recovery (S6), and the cost table with kappa = 2^{-182} (S7). It does not break. It is thinnest at the base, where the elementary stream lemmas (S1) are stated with only the controlled-shift mechanism sketched, and at the final 'disproving' clause, which is asserted without the liminf argument.

steps.note: h=100, banks X_a, Y_a indexed by a in T^3, N=v^3 with v=C(100,3), m=h^3, and the fixed network sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire.

Common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and each edge costing only the change D_v D_u^{-1}, stated in its role of freeing the intermediate frames.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3} of dimension m on every gate, nested labels on every edge, and the only decreases at central wires 3->4, each losing h.
rank(P_V - P_U) = dim V - dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, with the N first edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions.
Signed changes Wm-2N plus 2L with L=Ich gives Wm-2N+2L, and adding N source ranks gives s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b.
L_b/N = 100/539 and L_c/N = 101/539 below 1/2, deficit N - 2L_b > 0 (and 2N - 2L_c > 0), hence s < Wm.

M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp} + P_{U_a} = I_m for X_a, 0 to I otherwise), so with frames Phi_M the bit network applies H <- H + D on every role, scratch rows included.
A = E_1 Pi E_2 with triangular parts at linear cost and one interchange per one of Pi, so exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge and s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W < m^tau with tau = 1-2^{-50} from eta > 20*2^{-50} and log m < 20, and the geometric sum giving F_k = O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps are reconstructed with their defining content and in their roles: the fixed bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels with the single central loss, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b, L/N < 1/2 giving s < Wm, the endpoint identity giving the shear on every role, the E_1 Pi E_2 cost of exactly a interchanges, and the recurrence with tau = 1-2^{-50}. The plan carries the paper's central chain completely.
